title: Bed-Hold Leave Nights within a Medicare Part A Coinsurance Block (Resident Charge)
content:
**Held nights on a bed-hold leave and the resident coinsurance charge (Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage).** A night away at midnight on a bed-hold leave is not a covered day: when the bed-hold records book a leave for the charged block's service month, its held nights inside the charged block come off the days the resident coinsurance charge counts before the supplemental effective date, all of them when the last such night falls before that date, those from the first such night up to the day before the date when the date falls after the first such night and on or before the last, and none otherwise; when the month books no leave, none come off.

The leave is read from the resident's Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records: the held days booked for the same service month as the charged block, from the first to the last day of that booked span. Only the nights of that span that fall inside the charged block are considered.

| Supplemental effective date compared with the held nights inside the charged block | Nights that come off |
|---|---|
| Falls after the last such night | Every held night inside the charged block |
| Falls after the first such night and on or before the last | The nights from the first one up to the day before the date |
| Any other position | None |
| The service month books no bed-hold leave | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* the Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records book held nights from the 22nd to the 24th of the charged block's service month, all inside the charged block.
- Supplemental effective date the 26th: all three nights come off.
- Supplemental effective date the 23rd: the night of the 22nd comes off.
- Supplemental effective date the 20th: none come off.
